title: Endomorphism
description: JSON Schema for an endomorphism — a morphism f : A → A whose domain and codomain coincide (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. I §1). Endomorphisms at a single object form a monoid under composition; the monoid of endomorphisms of A is denoted End(A). Specializes transformer by the domain-equals-codomain condition; the equality is recorded as a single at-object cell.

at-object.description: The object A on which this endomorphism acts. Both domain and codomain of the morphism equal this object.
